caption: A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The hand must grip the tennis racket firmly and position it to strike the ball.
The ball must be struck with the side of the racket's head, not the strings, to produce an unexpected trajectory.
The racket must make contact with the ball while it is in motion, causing a deflection.
The resulting trajectory of the ball must visibly deviate from a normal tennis shot path.
